Simulation.//ExposeInternalEndpoints: Dev-only match-simulation endpoints (Phase 7.3). Never mapped in Production regardless; this flag lets non-prod environments also switch them off.

Jobs.//: Hangfire dev diagnostics (Phase 7.4). Never mapped in Production; these flags let non-prod also switch them off. The scheduler + recurring heartbeat run in every non-Testing environment.

Ranked.//: Public ranked pyramid shape (Phase 9.1). Defaults: 3 tiers of 8-club groups — tier 1 one group, tier 2 two, tier 3 four (56 seats, 48 of them placeable; tier 1 is promotion-only). New coaches play a placement season and the top finishers are sorted into tier 2, the rest into tier 3. When a world runs out of room the server opens another one.
Ranked.//Calendar: Real-time season calendar (Phase 9.2): one matchday per interval (default 1 day → a 14-matchday season runs in ~2 weeks) with two market windows (season start + midpoint), each open for a window duration. Staging can compress these to run a whole season fast.
Ranked.//MaxMatchdaysPerTick: Phase 9.6 safety valve: the most matchdays one calendar tick may resolve. 0 = no cap (the original behaviour); a cap bounds how long a single run can take on a big ladder, and the groups it skips resolve on the next minutely run.
Ranked.//Market: Ranked market economy (Phase 9.2b): each club is seeded StartingTransferBudget when its season starts, the money spent on direct coach-to-coach offers during a window; a coach cannot sell below MinSquadSizeForSale.
Ranked.//Auction: Every ladder lot opens at AuctionFlatStartPrice, the same for a phenom and a squad filler, so with equal budgets anyone can bid on anyone and the auction decides the price. 0 falls back on the private-league rule (half of market value).
Ranked.//Ranking: Coach ranking & seasonal reset (Phase 9.3). Elo moves after every matchday (K = EloKFactor; a vacant AI seat plays at AiRatingTopTier minus AiRatingPerTierStep per tier below the top) plus a finishing bonus at season end (SeasonEndPositionSwing from 1st to last, PromotionRatingBonus for going up / the same subtracted for going down). At the end of a season the group keeps its final table readable for SeasonBreakSeconds (1 week), then promotions/relegations are applied and the squads are re-equalised with fresh equal budgets so the next season starts fair and its first market window re-auctions the free agents.
Ranked.//ExposeInternalEndpoints: Dev-only ladder lifecycle endpoints (/internal/ranked/*): close a placement season, and advance the real-time calendar by hand (/internal/ranked/tick). Never mapped in Production regardless; the 9.2 season scheduler calls the service directly.

Integrity.//: Abuse & integrity (Phase 9.5). Transfer fees must stay inside a band around the player's market value (outside it the deal is refused and flagged; merely odd fees go through but are logged). Multi-account heuristics score two accounts from hashed address/device fingerprints and keep linked accounts out of the same group — they never ban. Lineups lock at kickoff. Rate limits are per ACCOUNT, in a rolling window, on the ranked write endpoints.
Integrity.//SignalSalt: DEV ONLY - override via Integrity__SignalSalt in every real environment. Rotating it makes every stored fingerprint uncorrelatable with the ones recorded before.

Dev.//ExposeSeedEndpoints: Dev-only online-league seeding endpoints (/internal/dev/*): create a ready test league (bots + draft) in one call, bot autopilot (bid/ready), reset. UNAUTHENTICATED — never mapped in Production regardless; set false to also switch them off in a non-prod environment.

Fcm.//: Firebase Cloud Messaging (Phase 7.4). Disabled by default so the server runs with no Firebase project — pushes are logged+skipped. To go live set Enabled=true and provide a service-account key via CredentialsPath (file) or Fcm__CredentialsJson (env/secret).

Jwt.//SigningKey: DEV ONLY — override via Jwt__SigningKey env in every real environment (min 32 bytes).
